en:
When I got t'the bar, your letter
was the first thing I noticed.

Oh no... The counter was too obvious. I made
it too easy for someone else to pick up...

Thanks, Kiryu-san.
That letter was real nice and heartfelt.

R-Right... Well, you've helped me a lot,
so I thought I'd say thank you for it...

I still remember the first time you
came to the bar. Maybe it was destiny.

H-Huh, Kiryu-san!?
Geez, that guy never rests...
No, I just got here!

What!? A-Akiyoshi-san...!
Why...?

What do you mean?
You told me to come here.

I was thinkin' 'bout baseball when I
saw your letter behind the poster.

Oh no... Obviously someone other than Mama
would notice it by the baseball poster...

I can't tell ya how happy I felt!
Your words really touched my heart, man!

R-Right... Well, you've been great at
baseball, so I wanted to say thanks...

Well, after that letter, Kiryu-san, I had t'come
and tell ya my feelings too... And...

H-Huh, Kiryu-san!?
I wasn't done talking!

I'll write the letter again... But I
need to choose a better spot for it.

Someone other than Mama might find it
here. I should put it somewhere else.
Did I make you wait?
It's fine, I just walked up myself.

Good. Sorry to make you wait,
and for dragging you all the way out here.

I was shocked. I went t'put tea in
the pot but there was a letter inside.

No one but you uses that teapot,
so I figured it'd be a good spot to put it.

Then y'should've just put it in the
mailbox. I always check that.

Oh, the mailbox.
I didn't think of that.
Y'don't think at all sometimes, Kiryu-san.

But, I was happy t'get it.
I've never gotten much gratitude for opening the bar.

Really. It'd be nice if the others could
spare a thought for me like you, Kiryu-san.

Well, it can be pretty tough to break
through your guard, according to Hatakeyama-san.
I ain't like that on purpose.
But I guess I hold men to a high standard.
Yeah? An old flame?

No way! Nothin' of the sort.
My father.
Your father?
Yeah, he was a fisherman.

He was everyone's friend, strong, kind...
He was a mighty fine father.
Was?

He went out t'sea on a fishing boat one
day n' never came back. It was ages ago.

He was a bar fly himself, so I figured if I
opened one, maybe he'd jus' stroll in one day...

T'be honest, that's why I opened it.
The bar, I mean.

My father may be gone, but I've laughed and
had fun with you and the others, Kiryu-san.

Heh, yeah? Well, thanks for keeping
the drinks flowing for us.

And who knows, maybe your dad will see
your bar someday, so don't you close it.

Yeah, which means I better get my sales up.
Y'better keep comin' around, Kiryu-san!
Can't let my guard down for a second.
Looks like a ship's comin' in.

I love the sound of those horns...
Makes me feel like he's comin' home.

Hey, Kiryu-san? Y'ever heard the phrase,
"Man makes the ship, women make the port?"
Hm? Not really...

The men go out t'work on the waves,
the women protect what they come home to...
Somethin' like that.

Oh, I see. A man can only focus on his
work if he knows his home is safe.

Well, there's a few ways of seein' it,
but I think it's about pure trust, and that's beautiful.

Yeah. It's nice to have a home to go back
to. A man with a port like that is lucky.
So the port makes him lucky, huh?

That reminds me, I never told y'my
name, did I?

Yeah. I've always just called you Mama,
but I've never asked.
My name is Minato.

That so? Mama Minato. 
It has a nice ring to it.

Really? Thanks. Do y'think
I'll find a nice ship someday?

Heh, I'm sure you will.
You deserve a world-class ship.

Y-You think so?
Because I think I've already found one.
Hm? What did you say?

No, nothing. Let's head back to the bar.
I left it open.

Yeah, everyone might be having a
drinking party without us.

They probably are!
Let's get going.

You know, I just realized I've never
asked how old you are.
Wise choice! <symbol=note_with_outline>
Oh, they're here!
Yer both so late!
Seriously, we were getting bored.

How is it that you guys are all hanging
around my bar without me here?

Details, details, let's not sweat 'em, now.
What matters is we're here now.
Anyway, us guys've been talkin' a bit...
Kiryu-san, y'oughta take this seat here.

Kiryu-san, you've helped us all out here.
I hardly remember a time y'weren't around.

Hear hear.
I wouldn't mess with Kiryu-san.
Kaneko-san... You guys...

You're right. Let's gather 'round Kiryu-san
and lift a glass!

Oh, amazing, Kiryu-san!
I think that was Mama's approval!
Move yer butt, Kiryu-san!
Oh... Yeah!

(Bars... You walk in to share a drink and a laugh,
but sometimes you walk out with a story...)

(Stories that turn strangers into family.
I like this little family. I'll never forget them.)
Whew, I'm feeling kinda buzzed.
The more y'drink, the more fun it gets.
Well guys, I'll see you around.
Kiryu-san! Soon I hope?
We'll be here!

Oh, Kiryu-san!
I've been waiting!

I heard from my diver friends that you
go spearfishing.

In that case, I have a present I want
to give you.
A present for me?

Yep, here.
It's yours!

It's... a speargun. 
Where did you get this?

My dad and I used t'spearfish
a little ourselves.

This was the gun I used. Talkin' to
you the other day reminded me of it!

I fixed it up a bit for ya.
It's not too shabby, if I do say so myself.

You're sure you want to give
me something this special?

That's exactly why I'm givin' it to ya.
You've been showin' us a great time.

Everyone seems t'be smiling more.
And this is my way of sayin' thanks.

Heh, I see.
I'm sure I'll make great use of it.

You're welcome. 
I'm real glad we met, Kiryu-san.
Hm? What the...
Whoa. Those are <font_kind=yakuza_italic>huge</font_kind>!

Aren't they amazing?
Pulled fresh out of the sea today.

Really?
Wait, did you catch these?

'Course not!
You've got him to thank for that.
Isao-san, this is a great haul!
Darn tootin'.

Been ages since I caught somethin' this nice.
How 'bout we celebrate with drinks n' sashimi?

That sounds fantastic!
I can prep it!
Huh? Who're you?

Just a passerby.
Don't mind me.

These fish really lured me in, though.
They're incredible.
That's nice of ya t'say.

I know, why don't y'join us?
Drinks n' sashimi on me!
I'm invited, too? But...

C'mon, don't go bein' shy on me now.
We ain't ever gonna eat this all on our own.

He's got a point. We have tons of fish
to go around, so you might as well join!

You sure?
All right, I'll take you up on that.
Mkay! Let's get ready t'party!
I'm stuffed t'the brim...
What a meal!

Thanks again.
That was really something special.

Don't worry 'bout it.
I'm jus' glad t'see a fresh face.

By the way, the name's Isao.
Pleased t'meet ya.

And I'm Amano, from Amano Fish.
I sell what Isao-san catches.

I'm Kiryu. Honestly, I'm pretty new to this place,
so it's nice to see some friendly faces.

Kiryu-san. How 'bout ya come out
fishin' with me next time?

Fer sure. Y'got a strong body, Kiryu-san.
Ya'd probly be an expert fisherman.
Sounds like fun.

Great. Well, I'll let ya know if I pull up
anythin' tasty in the future, Kiryu-san.

N' we're always 'round these parts,
so be sure t'come back.

(That fish was the freshest I've ever tasted.
I want to catch some myself sometime...)
(Wait... Isn't that Isao-san?)
Hey, Isao-san! Are you okay!?

I got real messed up out on the water...
Think y'can call a doctor fer me?
I'm on it...!

Sorry 'bout that...
Glad y'came fer me, Kiryu-san.
Are you okay now?

Thankfully, it wasn't anythin' too major.
Reckon I'm gonna be outta action fer a bit, though.
Sorry to hear that.

Isao-san! I heard you got hurt... You okay?
Don't tell me it got you again...
It did.
...<font_kind=yakuza_italic>It</font_kind>?

Oh, that's our problem.
Y'don't gotta worry yerself.

This ain't so good, though.
I'm gonna be outta commission fer a while.

I don't really mind... but Amano won't
have any fish if I ain't out catchin'.

Not much choice, though. I'll just have
to shutter up while Isao-san's hurt.

Y'can't do that, kid!
Yer mom's still sick, ain't she?

How're ya gonna pay fer her bills
if y'can't keep the store open?
You have a point, but...

Can't you just get fish from
the other fishermen in town?

To be honest, I'm still pretty new at this.
I don't really know anyone else yet.

Nobody trusts me with selling their catch.
Nobody but Isao-san, that is.

The other fishermen're real hardheaded.
Not an ounce of sympathy fer youth.

So, all the young'uns move to Tokyo instead.
Which leaves us with a bunch o' old farts.

But Amano here's a real passionate girl.
That passion's why I trust her t'sell my hauls.
But now... we're in a real pinch.
Huh? That's it!

Kiryu-san. Didn't ya say y'wanted
to try fishin' sometime?
Hm? I-I did...
Well, how 'bout ya do my fishin' fer me?
<font_kind=yakuza_italic>Me</font_kind>?
Yup. 'Course, I'll explain everythin' first.

There's no way... I don't have any experience,
let alone a license.

Well 'round here, y'can fish without
a license so long as I'm in the boat.

I can take care o' all the extra prep, too,
so y'don't gotta worry about a thing.
No buts, y'hear? The decision's simple!

Y'don't gotta do it as good as I do.
Jus' take it easy, act natural.

'Course, y'can keep whatever cash ya make
from selling yer hauls to Amano, too.

Ya get to fish <font_kind=yakuza_italic>and</font_kind> earn some spendin' money.
Two birds with one stone, yeah? Don't it sound good?

I'm beggin' ya, Kiryu-san. I wanna try
n' help Amano, even jus' a little bit.

We've gotta do our darnedest t'make sure
she can pay fer her mom's bills.
Y'mean it?

Yeah. I've never done this before, though.
I can't promise I'll be any good.
Kiryu-san... Thank ya!

This'll be such a big help! Are you sure, though?
It's not gonna be easy...

You treated me to an amazing meal earlier.
I'm just returning the favor.

Now, let's strike while the fish're bitin'!
Jus' talk to me when yer ready to head out.

Oh, Kiryu-san.
Y'ready to fish?
Talk t'me when ya wanna weigh anchor.
Mkay! I'll do the steerin'!
Well? How'd ya like fishin'?

It was tough...
But I can't say I didn't enjoy myself.

This big a haul on yer first go is amazin'.
I knew y'had talent for this, Kiryu-san.
Enough of the flattery.

Kiryu-san, here's your payment for today.
I threw in a little extra since it's your first time.

Yer gonna get paid jus' like this
dependin' on what ya haul up.

The more ya catch, the more money ya get.
Keep that in mind.

Oh, n' if ya fish real good in that one spot,
I'll even take ya over to new fishin' grounds.

These new places're tougher fer sure,
but they've got pricier fish. Eh, y'can do it.

Well then, fer the time bein'...
we're countin' on ya, Kiryu-san!

Well then, how about we have a drink and eat
some of this fish Kiryu-san caught?
You sure? Won't you run out of product to sell?

If it's a small amount, it'll be fine!
Right, Isao-san?

Yup! The first fish you catch should be commemorated.
It'll definitely be delicious, you should eat it.

Well then... It's time to prepare for a party!
Let's drink, Kiryu-san!

(I can't believe I'm fishing for these people.
Life takes you to strange places sometimes...)
Hey! Kiryu-san, lend us a hand!
Oh yeah, sorry, sorry.

Yo, Kiryu-san.
How 'bout a round of fishin'?
Great, I'll prep the boat!
Good work, Kiryu-san!
This will be today's payment.
I look forward to next time.

It was a big haul!
I look forward to next time.

It didn't go too well today.
I hope you can catch more next time.
But please...!
I told ya, there's no way!

What's going on?
Is something wrong?
Hm? Who are you?
Huh? You don't know who I am...?
At all...?
At all.

Kiryu-san... This man is one of the best
baseball players in the world, Kenji Gorchov-san.

So, what's a superstar like you
doing in a small town like this?
He said... he's looking for some octopus.

Accordin' to the legends, the tastiest octopus
species on the planet lives right 'round here.
They call it... the Delicious Octopus!
The Delicious Octopus...?

Yessir, it doesn't actually have no fancy
scientific name, so I just named it myself.

You named it... 
Does it really exist?

It sure does exist...
Though I've only caught a couple personally.
Why is that?

They're real bigguns, n' real violent, too.
Plus, they're near impossible t'catch.

Heard rumors 'bout fishermen goin' out to try,
but they 'parently never come back...
I've been in danger several times over it...
Huh. Sounds terrifying.
Maybe, but those things are delicious.
